additional_info.subject: ID0468478-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/S8170003941] Charging Cable Issue CRM:03289000027
additional_info.body:
Hello Laurenz, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the logs and I can see that these errors are happening during a reboot, you can see the log right before the errors:
The 2nd time it's because of user misusage:
The user doesn't even let the SECC establish connection and perform all the necessary steps, so it goes into error:
Not even 1 sec later it's already ready for usage:
If this error is not happening during a charging session then it's not relevant.
Please let me know if this answered your question and I can close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.body:
Dear Francisco,
Thank you for your analysis.
Regarding this case:
We worked together with
SPIE (our installation partner)
to resolve the issue. Initially, the problem could not be reproduced.
However,
Daniel, our service technician, was able to solve the problem the following week
.
Root cause identified:
The
plug connection between the cable and controller was not properly connected from the factory
.
The issue has been resolved and the ticket can be closed.
Thank you for your support.
With best regards,
